bio.text: Tami Zawistowski represents Connecticut's 61st House District (Suffield, East Granby and Windsor Locks) and was first elected in an April 2014 special election.
She is Caucus Policy Co-Chair and Chair of the House Republican Screening Committee, and serves on the Finance, Revenue and Bonding, Planning and Development, and Transportation committees.
She is a small business owner and a former bank executive vice president, and lives in East Granby.
